name: box-conformance-coverage
about: Which conformance case the Foundry tests check on today's contracts, and what waits (S2, launch pipeline v1 § 4 row S2, § 5; extended for the core v1 build by SH-core-wave-2 spec change 13 and for F74 in SH-F74-conformance). Declared by hand; `pnpm check:conformance` checks it against the case file and every Solidity file under packages/contracts/test, and renders docs/evidence/SH-S2-conformance-coverage.md.

`sources` name where case-named checks live (folders or files; a file belongs to the source whose path matches it most closely, so core/ is not the v2 harness's). Every `test_BCnnn_*` and `testFuzz_BCnnn_*` function under packages/contracts/test must sit in one of them and be listed in `cases` under its case and source; a `templateZeroOnly` source maps only cases for T0. `providers` name the test contracts that run a source's instance checks on a box. Since S10a a source may be `kind: typescript` (folders of vitest and Playwright tests outside packages/contracts/test): there every `it(…)` or `test(…)` whose title starts with `BC-nnn` is a check, listed under every case its title names.

Statuses are judged against the core v1 contracts (src/box/**), the contracts box 0 is built from; the v2 checks (S2's harness on today's Misfits contracts) are listed beside them. A case not listed is pending; the report gives its slice. A partial case that applies to T0 names in `waitsT0` what box 0 itself still waits for (a case whose box-0 part waits for nothing is checked); the report and `pnpm check:conformance` give each case's verdict for T0 and the Misfits gate's count of green G0 cases for T0 (review of the Misfits line, SH-misfits-line § Review).
